Hi Aisha,

We just spun up a trial on Redwood after reading your docs — looks promising. I lead platform at Kora (we ship a couple OSS tools and have an internal ML infra repo on GitHub). Two quick things:

- We're trying to understand if Redwood can be invoked from a GitHub Actions job (we'd like inference runs to be triggered as part of our CI bundles) or if customers need a separate runtime.
- We also want to validate cost/latency for a 1–5 RPS pilot with an open-source LLM.

Would love a short demo to see the integration patterns (GitHub, self-host, webhooks). I'm happy to share a short architecture doc — attaching a one-pager with our current flow.

Proposed attendees: me (platform), one engineer (Anil), and our product lead. Flexible on time next week.

Thanks,

Yes — Redwood supports request routing from CI (including GitHub Actions) via a small runner or webhook pattern depending on whether you want private VPC connectivity or hosted ingestion. We can walk through both during a 30-minute session.

Here are a few slots on my side next week:
- Tue 11/16 11:00 AM PST
- Wed 11/17 9:30 AM PST
- Thu 11/18 2:00 PM PST

If any of those work, book a slot here: https://calendly.com/aisha-redwood/demo-30m.

Warmly,
